chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, then Read the Current on Nibbit, using both energy on damage cards because the telegraphed 12 damage is not lethal and no Hydro interaction is stated on the page.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Coral Guard plus All Streams Flow to the Sea for 5 Block and 11 damage, but the enemy's declared 12 damage does not threaten my 48 HP, so I preferred the extra damage from Read the Current.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the 5 Block from Coral Guard, leaving me with no Block and taking the full 12 damage from Nibbit's declared attack.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had telegraphed a much larger attack, especially one where 5 Block would keep me above 0 HP, I would have prioritized Coral Guard over the second damage card.
